home.hero-description: One platform to learn, practice, sharpen your skills, prepare for interviews, and build your technical confidence

contact.title: A clearer path starts with a conversation
contact.description: Have a question, found something we should improve, or want to share an idea? Send us a message and help shape a better learning experience for developers
contact.supportTitle: Tell us what is on your mind
contact.supportDescription: Whether you are stuck on a feature or have an idea for the platform, your message goes to the right place
contact.supportCardText: Ask about your account, learning paths, interviews, or any feature that is not working as expected
contact.responseText: We usually review messages within 1–2 business days
contact.beforeMessageText: A little context helps us understand the problem and respond more usefully
contact.formDescription: Fill in the details below and we will get back to you
contact.successMessage: Thanks. Your message is ready for review.
contact.faqDescription: Here are a few things developers commonly ask before reaching out

account.question: How do I create an account?
account.answer: Choose Sign up from the navigation and complete the short registration form with your name, email, and password

free.question: Is Front Forge free to use?
free.answer: The platform is being built around accessible learning resources. Check the specific feature or course page for its current availability

issue.question: How can I report a technical issue?
issue.answer: Use the form above and include the page, the action you took, and what you expected to happen. That context helps us investigate faster

suggestion.question: Can I suggest a tutorial or article?
suggestion.answer: Yes. Send the topic, the audience it would help, and any useful references in your message

contribute.question: Can I contribute content to the platform?
contribute.answer: We welcome thoughtful ideas from the developer community. Tell us what you would like to contribute and we will review it

response.question: How long does it take to receive a response?
response.answer: We usually review contact messages within 1–2 business days. More context in your message helps us give a better first reply

contact.ctaDescription: Send the details and let us take a closer look
